findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean-squared-distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

Observed score times span the full learning window [0.0,0.5] at 0.01 spacing (50 nodes), and the label semantics state recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior; therefore no decoded terminal affinity labels exist in the supplied evidence and last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Continuous contrast functions over the complete observed support are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z +9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00, and landmark_00_local_dy shows 6 sign changes with first_rate_z -72.37 and last_rate_z +5.52; all listed fits are observed-node linear with polynomial_accepted=false and extrapolation_allowed=false, so a constant rule is not supported and time-conditioned behavior is indicated but not extrapolable.

Several local coordinate features carry strong sign conflicts (landmark_00_local_dx: 9 strong_sign_conflicts, 6 sign changes; landmark_00_local_dz: 7 strong_sign_conflicts, 10 sign changes) with relative_node_RMSE up to 0.78, so marginal per-coordinate descriptors are unstable and should not be averaged into a single target.

Joint diagnostics show a coherent, null-tested selection-innovation association: innovation_native_alignment mean 0.0918 (CI 0.081-0.103, p~1.5e-9, q~2.2e-9, positive_batch_fraction 1.0) and teacher_contrast_coherence mean 0.812 (CI 0.805-0.820, positive_batch_fraction 1.0), while observed_child_score_gain is negative (mean -0.0363, CI -0.043 to -0.030, p~1.8e-7, positive_batch_fraction 0.0); this supports coherent joint coordinate patterns over isolated marginals and flags that immediate selection evidence disagrees in sign with observed child score gain.

Descriptive joint metrics innovation_RMS_A (mean 0.0719) and teacher_contrast_RMS_A (mean 0.0657) are reported without null tests (p and q null), so they are descriptive only and cannot be ranked as significant coordinate hypotheses.

hypotheses.direction: time-conditioned contrast rather than constant contrast
hypotheses.falsifier: a constant rule matches or exceeds the observed-node fit fidelity (relative_node_RMSE) of the time-conditioned rule across the window
hypotheses.observable: observed-node contrast value of landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy across the 50 observed score times
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned contrast rule that follows the observed-node sign changes of landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy will track the observed contrast better than a constant rule over the window [0.0,0.5].

hypotheses.direction: prioritize coherent joint patterns; treat selection gain as non-predictive of later credit
hypotheses.falsifier: isolated marginal descriptors match the joint coherence association, or observed_child_score_gain turns positive and significant
hypotheses.observable: teacher_contrast_coherence, innovation_native_alignment and observed_child_score_gain at selection nodes
hypotheses.statement: Coherent joint coordinate patterns (high teacher_contrast_coherence and innovation_native_alignment) carry information beyond isolated marginal coordinate descriptors, and the negative observed_child_score_gain indicates immediate selection evidence should not be treated as later-label benefit.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so final affinity benefit and last-record/survival credit cannot be evaluated; the descendant-survival versus immediate-selection comparison is unavailable.
No current study outcome data are supplied to the Analyst role, so no claim about realized affinity improvement can be made.
Continuous fits are observed-node linear with polynomial_accepted=false and extrapolation_allowed=false; no extrapolation beyond [0.0,0.5] is permitted.
innovation_RMS_A and teacher_contrast_RMS_A are descriptive (p and q null) and are not multiplicity-adjusted support.
No uncertainty/multiplicity-adjusted ranking table beyond the delivered q-values was read, so a formal coverage-adjusted priority ordering is not established.
No regional, survival, increment, turnover or lineage tables were read in this turn, so parent-child increment versus cohort-composition accounting is not assessed here.

task.formula: R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau), q=detached-Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance; rho_delta=delta^2*(sqrt(1+q/delta^2)-1). Actual pointcloud_delta_A defaults to 1 A. Native endpoint VJP, no affinity-head derivative, no extra model forward. teacher_neighbors is a count; temporal_recipe changes only a registered scalar/attention, not velocity. No temperature edits. Inert legacy metadata is not a reward term.

formula_registry.diagnostic_limit: Moment effects, pair kernels and turnover are diagnostic evidence. Executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is inert.
formula_registry.dose: Endpoint-VJP force normalized and RMS-scaled against native predictive update; eta/ramp only in U lane.
formula_registry.prior: Detached nearest-k teachers; log_pi=-q_anchor/prior_temperature; scores beta=0; k is a count.
formula_registry.regional: Detached background plus Gaussian landmark attention; positive surrounding weight.
formula_registry.temporal_region: Same static teachers; validated absolute contrast changes regional attention at observed score nodes.
formula_registry.temporal_teacher: (1-blend)*R_static + blend*R_observed_teacher(time); same shared FLOWR endpoint, no velocity target.

incumbent.topology_policy: Free native graph transitions; no pair-distance acceptance or graph equality veto

task.objective: Final predicted target affinity primary; validity and strain secondary; coordinate control only
